terms.gloss: a triumph: the solemn entry of a victorious general into Rome; a victory
evidence: Cic. Phil. 14.23: Pharsālicae pugnae nē triumphum quidem ēgit (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: make a triumphal procession, hold a triumph; exult
evidence: Liv. 5.28.1: cum triumphantem albī per urbem vēxerant equī (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: Pharsālicae pugnae nē triumphum quidem ēgit
phrases.english: he did not even hold a triumph for the battle of Pharsalus

phrases.latin: cum triumphantem albī per urbem vēxerant equī
phrases.english: when white horses had drawn him through the city in his triumph
